title: Sour Gooey Stew
description: A hearty stew with a tangy twist, perfect for a cold evening. This unique stew combines the flavors of sour and gooey to create a truly unforgettable experience.
instructions: 1. Heat shortening in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
2. Add diced apples and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
3. Add waxy potatoes, stew seasoning, and enough water to cover. Bring to a boil.
4. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
5. Stir in gooey cheese until melted and well combined.
6. Serve hot, garnished with additional cheese if desired.
